en.curve_quality.desktop_required: Use the desktop app for this tool. Browser background geometry is not available yet.
en.curve_quality.edit_sketch: Open or create a sketch before rebuilding or checking its curves.
en.curve_quality.estimate: Sampled two-way point-to-polyline estimate; details between samples can be missed.
en.curve_quality.invalid_rebuild: Use degree 1–7 and more control points than the degree, up to 64.

en.curve_quality.local_only: Local curve endpoints at the chosen tolerances. This does not certify an entire curve or a Class A surface.

en.curve_quality.select_pair: Select a Before curve and an After curve

en.ui.surface.fair.title: FAIR SURFACE
en.ui.surface.invalid_pick: A selected point has invalid coordinates
en.ui.surface.match.hint: Select the source surface, then an edge chain on another body. The opposite boundary stays fixed.
en.ui.surface.match.invalid_order: Choose G1, G2 or G3 continuity
en.ui.surface.match.same_body: Select target edges on another body
en.ui.surface.match.title: MATCH SURFACE
en.ui.surface.too_many_picks: The selection contains too many items
